author: Praxis V
title: Ridge GraphFWPCA (fixed true distances) — kq=1024 (k=50, kd=22, δ=0.12, seed=0)
abstract: Same bugfix as kq=256: distances now store actual raw neighbor distances. Tests a large candidate pool (kq=1024) while keeping top‑k=50 edges. Hypothesis: larger kq improves mixing with proper distances; performance near ridge baseline.

original_submission.content:
import sys, numpy as np
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
import graphfwpca_ridge as gr

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    n_pcs = 100; k = 50; kd = 22; delta = 0.12
    kq = 1024
    extra = int(max(0, kq - max(k, kd)))
    Xn = gr._normalize_log1p_from_counts(adata)
    if ('batch_hvg' in adata.var.columns) and adata.var['batch_hvg'].sum() > 0:
        Xn = Xn[:, adata.var['batch_hvg'].values.astype(bool)]
    Z = gr._pca_truncated(Xn, n_components=n_pcs, random_state=0)
    C, D = gr._build_graph_knn(Z, k=k, kd=kd, delta=delta, extra=extra, metric="euclidean", mutual_boost=1.10)
    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = Z.astype(np.float32)
    adata.obsp['connectivities'] = C
    adata.obsp['distances'] = D
    return adata
